scope: One bounded development trial using six reviewed TRAIN additions. Same settings and initializer as v21 baseline. Equal epochs, not equal batch count, optimizer steps or wall clock because TRAIN size changed from91 to97.

trials.name: baseline
trials.hypothesis: Two additional independently sourced cut arrangements and four empty-vase negatives may improve PottedPlant/CutArrangement discrimination. This small data increment may not resolve observed errors; no acceptance is assumed.
